steps.text: 1. Gemba Walk (4:30am / 4:30pm)- One leader completes the department walkthrough.
2. Review Pass Down- Read all information from previous shift’s LSW. Ensure Accuracy of Pass down, collect previous shifts Major Clean check sheet from M1 mechanic’s.
3. Assign Team Members- Assign operators to Compressing Rooms 1–10. (Use the assignment board)
4. Shift Change Meeting (5:30am / 5:30pm)- Align on priorities, issues, and flow risks.
5. Witness Compressing Handoff- 1 Leader shall be physically present during the Compressing handoff.
6. Attend DDS Meeting 6am- Be present for the DDS Meeting
7. Verify Press Parameters: Confirm RPM matches Batch Record in all rooms.
a. Verify Target Weights
b. Verify Compressing Force - (IPR 3.5–6; Korsch <50)
c. Verify Press – Formula to calculate Press Speed (RPM X # of Press Stations X Feeders X Tips = TPM)
d. Verify MES Printed Sheets: Sequence, process card, and lot numbers match current WO.
e. Verify Press HMI Lot # matches MES/Batch Record.
f. Verify Proper AQL’s Are Performed
g. Verify Hourly SPC Checks & Review SPC History
h. Verify Shake Test & Metal Detector Checks Completed
I. Reconcile Current Batch Record: Correct all Compressing errors before the next process step.
8. Capture UPDT in Real Time- Update accurately throughout the day
9. Complete 2D Problem Solving Form: Required for downtime exceeding 1 hour
10. Record Defects: 1 defect per shift; update online spreadsheet and strike through corrected defects on physical list.
11. Verify Composites Samples Collected (for each room)
12. Verify Material Supply (bags, gloves, pallets, MES sticker labels, Zebra printer ribbon, and PPE)
13. GMP & Safety- Verify GMP adherence & safety hazards.
14. MSS Compliance- Ensure MSS tasks are progressing. Tasks Completed – Circle (Wk, Mo, Qt) _______ Tasks Remaining_______
15. Complete 5S Checklist for Compressing Suites
16. Ensure M1’s update Compressing MDI & Changeover Board at the end of the shift
17. Update Production Schedule – Check off WOs as completed.
18. Verify Major Clean Changeover Checklist - Include details in pass down.
19. Ensure Blended Material Is Charged Correctly. (Desk activity requires JDE)
20. Close Out Completed Batches postproduction
21. Mid-Shift Check for Quality Issues (lubrication leaks, defects, powder leaks)
22. Verify CIL Completion
23. Verify the dust collection ports are halfway open
24. Verify Next Batch Record (All Presses): Check for errors and confirm Planner, Weigh Staging & Blending signoffs before Compressing
25. Ensure Mezzanine Operator - Keeps Presses Supplied
26. Verify Correct Blended Material Staged
1. Gemba Walk (4:30am / 4:30pm)- One leader completes the department walkthrough
2. Review Pass Down- Read all information from previous shift’s LSW. Ensure Accuracy of Pass down, collect previous shifts Major Clean check sheet.
3. Assign Teams- Assign Blending teams in the office. (Use the assignment board)
4. Shift Change Meeting (5:30am / 5:30pm)- Align on priorities, issues, and flow risks.
5. Witness Blending Handoff- 1 Leader shall be physically present during the Blending handoff.
6. Attend DDS Meeting 6am- Be Present for the DDS Meeting that occurs daily on weekdays
7. Review Blending Schedule- Confirm priorities, coverage, and 12hour flow. (Prior to going to the 3rd floor)
8. Verify WO’s Staged on Third Floor - Coordinate with Weigh Room Leader to send orders upstairs
9. Must Kit Next WOs for 125 & 250 Prior to Starting the Next Order- Ensure next WO for each room is broken into proper stages according to the Batch Record.
10. Stage AC3 (Two Barrels Minimum)- Ensure AC3 supply is always ready. If AC3 skids are empty notify MRO. (Send empty containers downstairs)
11. Fill Gamma Jet with Water + AC3- Follow recipe requirements. (External Major Clean activity)
12. Documentation Accuracy- Process cards, logbooks, batch records completed correctly.
13. Current Batch Record Reconciliation- Errors corrected before next process step.
14. Capture UPDT in Real Time: Ensure the team has a downtime sheet and records unplanned downtime as it occurs.
15. Complete 2D Problem Solving Form: Required for downtime exceeding 1 hour
16. MSS Compliance- Ensure MSS tasks are progressing.  Tasks Completed (Wk, Mo, Qt,) __________ out of Tasks Remaining ____________
17. GMP & Safety- Check for GMP adherence and safety hazards.
18. Ensure Two Skirts Are Cleaned and Available- Maintain readiness for Major Change Over operations.
19. Send Extra Containers Downstairs Immediately- Prevent charging unplanned quantity of material into a WO.
20. Verify Material Supply- Clean bulk bags, pallets, Zebra printer labels, PPE available on second floor.
21. Ensure Liner Bags Are Available- One pallet minimum.
22. Make Bags for Next Discharge- Prepare ahead to prevent.
23. Ensure Two Skirts Are Cleaned and Available- Maintain readiness for Major Change Over operations.
24. Return Used Bins Downstairs- Maintain bin flow and prevent UPDT. (On the 2nd floor)
25. Capture UPDT in Real Time- Ensure team is recording UPDT in real time.
26. Stage Blended Material: Keep each Compressing suite supplied. Stage bags in FIFO order; charge bag #1 first, then #2, #3, and #4.
27. Complete Mezzanine 5S Checklist- Ensure workplace organization.
28. Update Production Schedule- Check off WO’s accordingly (Picked/Blend Complete)
29. Update Blending MDI & Changeover Boards- Keep visual management current.
30. Prepare Pass Down Document and communicate shift information.

title: Tableting Weigh Room & Bin Blending Leader Standard Work
source: Tableting Weigh Room Leader Standard Work.docx

steps.text: 1. Gemba Walk (4:30am / 4:30pm)- One leader completes the department walkthrough.
2. Review Pass Down- Read all information from previous shift’s LSW. Ensure Accuracy of Pass down, collect previous shifts Major Clean check sheet.
3. Assign Teams- WR, Bin Blending, Inspection. (Use the assignment board)
4. Shift Change Meeting (5:30am / 5:30pm)- Align on priorities, issues, and flow risks.
5. Witness Weigh Room Handoff- 1 Leader shall be physically present during the Weigh Room handoff.
6. Attend DDS Meeting 6am- Be present for the DDS Meeting that occurs daily on weekdays
7. Review Weigh Room Schedule- Confirm priorities schedule with Weigh Room Operators in room A, B, C, & D, ensure there are enough WOs for 12hours.
a. Verify Material Supply- Teams have clean bags, labels, PPE, and required materials in each room.
b. Documentation Accuracy- Verify process cards, logbooks, and batch records are fill out correctly.
c. Capture UPDT in Real Time- Update accurately throughout the day.
d. Batch Record Reconciliation- Errors corrected before next process step.
e. GMP & Safety- Check for GMP adherence and safety
8. MSS Compliance- Ensure MSS tasks are progressing. Tasks Completed (Wk, Mo, Qt) ________ Tasks Remaining _________

9. Communicate with Blending Leader to verify what WO’s are Picked for (125CF & 250CF)- Ensure at least two WO’s are ready for each blender. If order is not present, get with WHS and verify if a Pick List has been updated.
10. Communicate with Blending Leader to verify what WO’s need Staging for (125 & 250) – Stage WO according to the Batch Record.
11. Verify Production Schedule and follow Up with Gummies/Softgel - Ensure weighs/blends will be completed on time to prevent UPDT.
12. Update Bin Blending Kanban- WO’s are stacked vertically in rack locations; Kanban must match reality.
13. Maintain Partial Area Flow- Return unused partials; no pallets on floor; replenishments put away.
14. Move Completed Partials Forward- Verify the partials according to the Batch Record Steps before going upstairs. Return unused partials to their partial location.
15. Return Used Bins Downstairs- Keep bin flow continuously to prevent UPDT.
16. GMP & Safety- Check for GMP adherence and safety hazards.
17. Inspection Documentation- Confirm proper documentation and daily inspection goals.*Temporary moved to Coating AC3*
18. Batch Record Reconciliation- Errors corrected before next process step.
19. External Bin Cleaning- Third person cleans bins; leave next shift 3 clean bins.
20. Complete 2D Problem Solving Form: Required for downtime exceeding 1 hour
21. Complete 5S Checklist- Ensure workplace organization.
22. Update Production Schedule- Check off WO’s as completed.
23. Update MDI & Changeover Boards- Keep visual management current.
24. Prepare Pass Down- Document and communicate shift information.
1. Gemba Walk (4:30am / 4:30pm)- One leader completes the department walkthrough.
2. Review Pass Down- Read all information from previous shift’s LSW. Ensure Accuracy of Pass down, collect previous shifts Major Clean check sheet.
3. Assign Team Members- CC1, CC2, AC3, & AC4. (Use the assignment board)
4. Shift Change Meeting (5:30am / 5:30pm)- Align on priorities and issues.
5. Witness Coating Handoff- 1 Leader shall be physically present during the Coating handoff.
6. Attend DDS Meeting 6am- Be present for the DDS Meeting that occurs daily on weekdays
7. GMP & Safety- Check for GMP adherence and safety hazards.
8. Verify Weigh Belt Centering- Prevents product loss.
9. Verify ZConveyor Alignment- Centered under weigh belt; top aligned with hopper mat.
10. Verify Chute Alignment- Ensure chute is not rubbing against infeed ring.
11. Verify Spray Bars Are Spraying (First sprayers #1 & #2 shouldn’t be spraying when Coater is in continuous mode)
11.1 Verify that the air-knife is working
12. Verify Weigh Belt Check- Capture product for 1 minute before starting next order
13. Verify Infeed/Outfeed Pump Output- Pumps must operate between 20–30%. (Critical Step)
14. Make Solution When Tank Is Available- Minor changeover; solution good for 24 hours.
15. Mixer Control- Clear solution → turn mixer off Colored solution → slow speed (60–65 rpm)
16. Verify MES Printed Sheets- Sequence & lot numbers must match. Perform in (CC1, CC2, AC3, & AC4) It’s recommended to do each room one at a time to prevent overprocessing
17. Batch Record Reconciliation- Correct errors before turning into coordinators.
18. Ensure Proper AQL’s Are Performed- Team members perform additional spot checks.
19. Verify Bags Staged for Order in (CC1, CC2, AC3, & AC4) – (Production schedule needed to perform this activity)
20. Verify Material Supply- Clean bags, pallets, collapsible, MES labels, PPE.
21. Verify Coating Solution is Planned/Picked/Weighed for (CC1, CC2, AC3, & AC4)
22. Verify Actual Weight of Product Containers- Determines target pan load for AC3/AC4.
23. Recalculate Last 4 Rounds (AC3/AC4)- Confirm pan load accuracy.
24. Update Coating WO Board
25. Ensure Next BR from Compressing Is Reconciled for (CC1, CC2, AC3, & AC4)
26. Close Out Completed Batches for (CC1, CC2, AC3, & AC4)
27. Capture UPDT in Real Time- Update accurately throughout the day
28. Complete 2D Problem Solving Form: Required for downtime exceeding 1 hour
29. Verify Changeover Checklist – Must be completed and submitted to DL
30. Update Production Schedule – Check off WOs as completed.
31. Inspection Documentation- Confirm proper documentation and daily inspection goals. *Temporary moved to Coating AC3*
32. Complete 5S Checklist- Between DL office and Coating.
33. MSS Compliance- Ensure MSS tasks are progressing.  Tasks Completed (Wk, Mo, Qt) ______________ Tasks Remaining ________________
34. Ensure Composite Samples Collected (1200 piece)
34. Check for Quality Issues- Leaky sprayers, weigh belt speed, product defects.
36. Update Coating MDI & Changeover Boards
37. Update Production Schedule – Check off WOs as completed.
